title: Ember Lake
kicker: A hot spring lake that points toward buried divine industry and gives Sablewood a heat source older than any concession.
hook: A hot spring lake that points toward buried divine industry and gives Sablewood a heat source older than any concession.

blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: Ember Lake steams under cool canopy air, a hot spring mirror that suggests something older is still working below Sablewood.

blocks.label: Known For
blocks.body: The cold gets to your fingers before the lake appears. Then the trees thin, and orange light moves under the black water like coals being stirred beneath glass. Steam beads on cloaks and eyelashes. Someone has left a kettle on a flat stone with no fire under...

blocks.label: Food And Texture
blocks.body: Dinner happens on the rocks. Someone lays a fish straight onto a stone too hot to touch and it hisses and curls and smells like the sea got lost in a forest. Kettles sit along the bank with nothing burning under them...
